files./init.d/rcS:
set +e
set +e
losetup /dev/loop0 /system/zoneinfo/zoneinfo.img
mount -t romfs /dev/loop0 /mnt/zoneinfo
if [ ! -d /data/nobusiness ]; then
miwear_bluetooth &
usleep 1
fi
miwear_algo_service &
miwear_activity_service &
miwear_capture_service &
nfc_stack_bridge &
if [ ! -d /data/nobusiness ]; then
miwear &
fi
if [ -d /data/nolowpower ];then
pmconfig stay normal
fi
files./init.d/rc.sysinit:
set +e
       mount -t procfs "/proc"
mount -t tmpfs /tmp
miwear_inject
pmconfig stay normal
echo "mount /system"
mount -t yaffs -o ro /dev/nand_system /system
echo "mount /data"
mount -t yaffs -o autoformat /dev/nand_data /data
offline_log start &
kvdb_init
kvdbd &
miwear_rtc_checker
charger_manage &
healthd &

miwear_inject_behavior: Sets libuv and algorithm allocator callbacks. Does not load a user module or a /data script.
p67_reference: work/p67-upstream/installer/chaos_installer.lua: build_chaos_sh uses insmod and /data/rc.d; rc_dir_ready requires an external autorun manager.
conclusion: No /data boot-script consumer found in these init scripts. Persistent native autostart is not implemented by this watchface package.
